messages:
anya: Quick postmortem from late-night canary: several customers reported unexpectedly high provisional token usage during streaming when toolcalls returned partial chunks + truncation. Root seems to be chunk-level truncation + client retry causing duplicate chunk credits.
sam: can you paste a minimal repro/log?
anya: yes. router excerpt below:
```
[2024-02-10T02:14:01Z] session=gh12 route=canary stream_id=s-9 chunk_id=1/4 status=ok
[2024-02:14:03Z] session=gh12 toolcall id=tool-tts status=truncated chunk=2/4 bytes=512 reason=early_eof
[2024-02:14:03Z] client retry chunk_retry=2 new_session=gh12b old_session=gh12
[2024-02:14:04Z] billing provisional session=gh12 tokens=150 chunk_ids=[1,2]
[2024-02:14:04Z] billing provisional session=gh12b tokens=160 chunk_ids=[2,3]
```
kevin: interesting: chunk 2 shows up on both sessions. Our ledger keys are session-scoped which means chunk-level de-dupe across sessions fails.
lucy: can we use a stable chunk fingerprint (sha1 of request+chunk_index) and use that as ledger key so retries with new session reuse same chunk key?
sam: We already have a request-id header but router creates new request-id on reconnects to prioritize latency. If we keep that behavior we lose dedupe. Option A: preserve original request-id across reconnects. Option B: emit chunk_fingerprint from the client side (difficult). Option C: reconciler dedupe using chunk fingerprint computed from prompt+chunk_index+model-version.
anya: Option C seems safest short-term: reconciler will group provisional entries by chunk_fingerprint and merge duplicates within a 2-minute window. We need to compute fingerprint consistently: sha256(prompt_normalized + model + chunk_index). We'll add normalization rules to avoid whitespace churn.
kevin: caveat: different model versions might legitimately produce different token counts; merging could under-credit. Heuristic: only merge when bytes_delta < 30% and tokens_delta < 20% OR when toolcall returned explicit TRUNCATION marker.
lucy: can we get the tool service to emit a structured truncation flag (x-tool-truncated: true) on partial responses? That would make merges safe.
anya: I'll ask tool-team to add that. For short-term reconciler heuristic we gate merges on either truncation flag OR both small deltas.
sam: Console UX: customers see repeated provisional lines for same request. We should show a collapsed view grouping merged chunks and an expandable "pre-merge" list. Also add an annotated timeline note "merged duplicate chunk #2 due to reconnect" with link to trace.
kevin: telemetry to add: reconciler.chunk_merge_attempts, reconciler.chunk_merge_successes, reconciler.chunk_merge_reject_reasons. Also router.request_id_preserved_count to measure how often request-id is preserved across reconnects.
anya: Rollout plan: reconciler patch behind feature flag reconciler.chunk_merge_v2; enable reconciler in read-only mode first (flag that computes merges but doesn't trigger refunds or billing changes) for 24h, display metrics in Console. If stable, enable write mode to emit merge_id and call billing resolve endpoint.
anya: billing-bot: what's the downstream API for merges?
billing-bot: POST /internal/billing/merge with payload {merge_id, fingerprint_list, merged_tokens, sessions}. We'll expect reconciler to include merge_id and human-readable reason. Auto-refund policy: finance says auto-refund allowed if merged_tokens < $5000 per merge and daily volume < threshold; we'll add throttles.
kevin: Implementation split: reconciler (compute fingerprint, heuristics, emit merge_id), router (optionally preserve request-id on reconnects behind a flag), billing (accept merge requests), console (UI for merged provisional grouping + timeline note). I'll own reconciler + tests. Lucy can own console bits.
lucy: ack. Console items: new card in Cost Explorer: "Merged provisional tokens" with drilldown to original items. Also a toggle to "show pre-merge items" for support.
sam: Tests: unit for fingerprint hashing + normalization, integration simulating truncation + reconnect where tool returns truncation flag, e2e verifying console shows merged group and that merge_id triggers billing resolve.
anya: Safety heuristics draft: only merge when (a) truncation_flag=true OR (b) tokens_delta <= 20% AND bytes_delta <= 30% AND time_delta <= 120s. Also never merge if sessions come from distinct client_account ids.
ops-bot: Scheduled job: reconciler-canary -> canary-cluster -> 2024-02-11T06:00Z. /deploy reconciler-canary
kevin: We'll also emit a special alert when reconciler's merge_reject_no_truncation_count > 100 in 1h so we know how many misses are due to missing tool flag.
anya: Good. And open a small doc PR describing fingerprint deterministic rules and the console UX text. I'll also add runbook steps for ops: how to revert merges, manual refund flow.
sam: One more ask: telemetry correlate merges to customer support tickets (tag merges with trace id). That will help measure customer impact.
billing-bot: We'll throttle auto-refunds to 5/min initial and cap daily refunds to avoid surprises; will require finance review if exceeded.
anya: OK. PRs incoming: reconciler fingerprint + metrics (kevin), router request-id-preserve flag (kevin), tool-team truncation header (ask sent), billing merge endpoint (billing team), console grouping UI (lucy). We'll iterate after canary metrics.
lucy: thanks, will mock UI today and share screenshots in #design.
sam: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
